reports.title: Lifting the lid on cults and coercion
reports.description: How should media handle people caught up in cults? The maker of Netflix hit False Prophet has also been on the receiving end. Read more about this episode of Mediawatch on the RNZ website RNZ blowout = big cuts + big hit to reputation In this episode: 1:35 RNZ's pressing ahead with cuts by Christmas, staff are pushing back - and politicians and pundits are piling in on the plan. 18:00 How should the media handle the stories of people caught up in cults and coercion? Phil Vine - maker of RNZ's The Lodge and new series Cultproof - asks Dr Christine Marie, the woman behind Netflix hit False Prophet - and local cult specialist journalist Anke Richter, the organiser of the DeCult conference in Christchurch.
